notes.title: 🚨 Attention Survivors of Acclimate! 🚨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42558614/8d88411df2905b19a00343f02d62f952f376ea21.png[/img]Prepare for the unforgiving lands to evolve before your eyes. In one of our biggest updates. We have spent the last few months redesigning major aspects of the game. Get ready to embrace the wilderness like never before in the upcoming V0.9 update!

What to expect:

Brave new climates as you traverse through the freshly blanketed Snow and the scorching Desert biomes.
Seek shelter and strategize in revamped buildings complete with new furnishings and textures.
Feel the adrenaline with enhanced enemy speeds and a more immersive shooting experience.
Experiment with godlike powers in our secretive Dev/Cheat menu – are you tempted to cheat?
Craft, conquer, and survive with advanced workbenches and an array of items never seen before.
Navigate the dangers with improved systems, from improved enemy spawning to improved terrain loading, all designed for a seamless journey.

Stay alert for signals on the horizon. Update V0.9 is closer than you think... Are you prepared to adapt?

notes.title: The Biggest Update Yet
notes.content:
Throught the last few months I have been making significant changes to improve the performance and overall feel of the game. This was one of the biggest updates I have made to the game so far, and I hope you all can see and feel the changes. Through out the next few months I will work towards populating the map, added more things to build and improving the performance. Thank you all for testing and providing feedback and for your patience. [h1][b]Please Be sure to start a new game.[/b][/h1]

notes.title: We Need Feedback
notes.content: Hey everyone if you experience issues within the game (we are sure there are many issues) or would like to request a feature, please join the [url=https://discord.gg/cjfhShbAWN]Discord [/url](also linked on the steam page) and post them in the bugs section. Do not hesitate to post issues, keep the issues coming. Without feedback the game will always remain broken. If you have friends who can test please refer the game to them, PlayTest is open to everyone. Feedback at any stage is important even more now than ever, please join the discord and post feedback/complains there.

notes.title: Update 0.7.8
notes.content:
Hello,

Acclimate testers, it has been a little over two weeks since our last update. We just wanted to let the community know that we are working on a big update that will finally bring some major survival aspects into the game. We hope that the community will continue to support us as we continue to develop and improve this game. We are sorry for the extended time between updates.
